name: umo-sdlc
description: UMO SDLC v1 — doc bucket structure, design, lifecycle, and audit. Service buckets at services/<svc>/docs/ are spec-driven and anchored on PASSPORT.md (canonical service identity). Library buckets at repo root or in a domain repo are knowledge stores. Three skills: docs-setup, docs-lifecycle, docs-audit.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize and audit service-scoped and library docs across UMO repos.
interface.longDescription: v1 of umo-sdlc owns documentation buckets. Service buckets at services/<svc>/docs/ are spec-driven and anchored on PASSPORT.md, which carries machine-readable identity (domain, teams, network dependencies, exposed contracts) and is the first file an agent reads when recalling service context. Library buckets at repo root or in a domain repo are knowledge stores. Both share the same building blocks (proposals, adr, guides, reference, incidents, archive). Three skills: docs-setup (bootstrap any bucket, create PASSPORT for service buckets), docs-lifecycle (every create/promote/archive action, including PASSPORT updates), docs-audit (validate an existing bucket and autofix safe issues, flags missing PASSPORT). AGENTS.md, beads, planning, memory, review, and KPIs are explicitly out of scope.
defaultPrompt: Set up the docs bucket for this service.
Audit the docs structure here and autofix what's safe.
Update the PASSPORT — the network deps changed.
Write a proposal for this service.
